Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE login flow for public clients using google-auth-oauthlib.
Replace 'YOUR_CLIENT_ID.apps.googleusercontent.com' with your actual client ID
from Google Cloud Console (Desktop application type, add http://localhost:8080/
as authorized redirect URI).
"""

import webbrowser
from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow
from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials

CLIENT_CONFIG = {
    "installed": {
        "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID.apps.googleusercontent.com",
        "auth_uri": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth",
        "token_uri": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
        "redirect_uris": ["http://localhost:8080/"],
    }
}

SCOPES = [
    "openid",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email",
]

def main():
    flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_config(CLIENT_CONFIG, SCOPES)
    # Automatically uses PKCE since no client_secret is provided
    credentials = flow.run_local_server(
        port=0,
        open_browser=True,
        authorization_prompt_message="Please visit the following URL to authorize this application: "
    )
    print("Access token:", credentials.token)
    print("ID token:", credentials.id_token)
    print("Refresh token:", credentials.refresh_token)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
